entries.240542764ef7fc24: This reportable segment conducts power generation and electricity sales and integrated energy supply businesses on an integrated basis. It is the largest of the three reportable segments, with revenue from external customers of ¥1,201,930 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026. Revenue decreased from the previous year, due to a decrease in the fuel cost adjustment amount resulting from lower fuel prices, although retail electricity sales volume increased. Power generation comes from hydro, thermal, nuclear, new energy and other sources, and sales are divided between retail sales of lighting and power and sales to other companies. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, Shimane Nuclear Power Plant Unit 2 came into operation, and nuclear power generation volume significantly exceeded the previous year.
entries.3a540a92c6afc586: In September 2025, it announced the “Chugoku Electric Power Group Management Vision 2040” and formulated the “Chugoku Electric Power Group Medium-Term Management Plan (2026-2030)” as its implementation plan. As growth strategies, it cites securing large-scale power sources such as Shimane Nuclear Power Station Unit 3 (aiming to start commercial operation by fiscal 2030) and the new Yanai Power Station Unit 2 (provisional name) (aiming to start operation in July 2030), expanding regional power demand through electrification of industrial energy use, and strengthening the electricity value chain.

entries.f78d88611c82b666: The group is made up of the company, 28 subsidiaries and 29 associated companies, 58 in total (as of March 31, 2026). It has defined three strategic business areas, the Comprehensive Energy Business, the Transmission and Distribution Business and the Information and Communications Business, and designates them as [[term:segment|Reportable Segments]].
